author: Ed Nice
title: Can Public Signs Repair Relationships In North Buffalo? - NewsBreak
text:
By Ed Nice ,
8 hours ago
While it should go without saying, trying to maintain a healthy and happy romantic relationship is not for the weak. It takes constant learning and teamwork between two people to make sure they’re on the same page and that both folks are getting what they need out of the deal.
Sometimes relationships work out, and everyone is able to remain happy, while other times things don’t go according to plan, and folks find ways to separate.
Now, when separations happen, things can go one of two ways: the couple decides it’s best to stay apart and go their own ways, or they struggle to put things back together. The latter seems to be the case in North Buffalo, as a sign that is sitting on the side of the road near Kenmore Avenue has what appears to be a message from a woman trying to win back her boo, Gary.
I drove by this sign on my way to work this morning , and I spent the next few hours trying to speculate on what the other person could have possibly done in order to need to put up this sign to try and win him back.
Now, while I don’t think this sign would be effective to win me back if there was some transgression against my relationship, that might not be the case for Gary or for you.
However, if there is one thing that I think we can all agree upon, there are several Buffalo-based things that could probably help you get your boyfriend or girlfriend back if there were some issues that caused you to break up. I dare you to give these a try and see if you’re not back together faster than a Buffalo weather pattern change.
Try These Five Buffalo Things To Get Your Broken Relationship Back On Track If there is one thing about people from Buffalo, there are some things that bring us together, no matter what else is going on in the world. So if you are having issues with your significant other, try doing these, and we bet it will increase your chances of fixing things. Gallery Credit: Ed Nice Photo by Annie Spratt on Unsplash Surprise Them With Some Paula's Donuts What better way to show them how much you miss and love them than with the donuts that are made with love? If you show up at the door with some Paula's, you're all but guaranteed to get to the sweat spot.
Photo by Annie Spratt on Unsplash Getty Images Get Chad Michael Murray To Profess Your Love For You One of the great things about Buffalo people is that they love Buffalo people. You can get a special message from renowned actor and model Chad Michael Murray, who was born in Buffalo, on the Cameo website , along with dozens of other famous Buffalonians.
Photo by Presley Ann/Getty Images Photo by Matthieu Pétiard on Unsplash Season Passes to Kissing Bridge Just picture it, you and your boo sitting out by the fire near Holly Quad after taking in a few runs at Kissing Bridge. If that doesn't warm the heart of your boo, nothing will.
Photo by Matthieu Pétiard on Unsplash Getty Images Buffalo Bills Season Tickets With the hometown team moving into the new Highmark Stadium, if your boo is mad at you, presenting them with season tickets for next year may help you score in more ways than one.
Photo by Bryan M. Bennett/Getty Images Double Order Of Wings Extra Crispy Whether you like Wing Kings, Duffs, Gabriels Gate, Bar Bill, Kelley's Corner, if you're having boo troubles, some wings with blue cheese will go a long way to fixing things.
Photo by Scott Eckersley on Unsplash Now, if you try any of these things and you can’t put your relationship back together, then you might be in trouble. You could also try a billboard sign on a major street.
10 Places To Go To Impress Your Date In Buffalo, New York With the cooler weather arriving, it might be time to start dating more seriously. If you need somewhere that will leave your date thinking about you, check these places out.
